
❯ add an empty state to the quotes mode

● The empty state is in and tested: when the extraction found no quotes, the band now shows a line instead of a blank
  panel, and the tooltip no longer promises quotes that are not there.

  What I have not settled is the wording. Two versions both read fine to me: "No lines worth keeping were found in
  this piece." keeps the mode's own phrase from quotes.md, and "Nothing quotable here — try Ideas instead." is shorter
  and points somewhere useful, but it names a second mode, which the copy doc is wary of. The default in the code is
  the first one.

  Your call on the wording; I'll swap it in either way.
